import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    d = float(data[1])
    for i in range(n + 1):
        # Compute probability using only floating point arithmetic
        # Terms: 
        # term1 = 1.5 * i * (n-i) * (n-i-1) / (n * (n-1) * (n-2))
        # term2 = 3.0 * i * (i-1) * (n-i) / (n * (n-1) * (n-2))
        # term3 = 1.0 * i * (i-1) * (i-2) / (n * (n-1) * (n-2))
        # Combine denominators to avoid repeated division
        denom = float(n * (n-1) * (n-2))
        term1 = 1.5 * i * (n-i) * (n-i-1) / denom
        term2 = 3.0 * i * (i-1) * (n-i) / denom
        term3 = 1.0 * i * (i-1) * (i-2) / denom
        prob = term1 + term2 + term3
        if prob + 1e-8 >= d:
            print(i)
            break
    sys.stdout.flush()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
